description: One attribute value reported for one group route of an endpoint group. A group's state is the set of its group routes' values; values from different providers are never aggregated, so each entry names the group route and the provider that reported it.

groupRouteId.description: The typed ID of the group route the value was reported for.

pluginId.description: The plugin that owns the group route and reported the value.

provider.description: The display name of that plugin.

namespace.description: The capability interface namespace for this attribute

name.description: The name of the attribute within the namespace

version.description: The capability interface version the value conforms to.

value.description: The attribute value payload, structure depends on the attribute schema

sampledAt.description: When the provider observed the value. Omitted when the provider did not say.
